grade_rationale: 4 P1 findings (threshold: ≤2 for C). Two critical RCE CVEs (CVSS 9.8) in production dependencies. One unregistered required route with 6 permanently failing tests. Spec directory mapping entirely undocumented.

summary.skip_reason: All services offline during audit cycle (backend: http://localhost:3001 unreachable)

escalations.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution
escalations.fix: npm update protobufjs in platform/orchestrator and portal/Backend

escalations.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS — REST routes hang under malicious input
escalations.fix: npm update path-to-regexp in platform/orchestrator and portal/Backend

escalations.title: OpenTelemetry Prometheus metrics endpoint crash on malformed requests

backlog.title: GET /api/search unregistered — FR-dependency-search unimplemented, 6 tests failing
backlog.fix: Create Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts and register in app.ts. Add // Verifies: FR-dependency-search.

backlog.title: Spec directory ↔ Source/ mapping undocumented; workflow-engine.md has no FR IDs
backlog.fix: Add spec→directory cross-links in all three spec documents. Add FR-WF-* IDs to workflow-engine.md. Fix enforcer --plan flag.

backlog.title: Routes call store directly — service layer bypassed (architecture violation)
backlog.fix: Create Source/Backend/src/services/workItemService.ts. Route all CRUD handlers through the service layer.

backlog.title: OpenTelemetry tracing entirely absent from Source/ (architecture violation)
backlog.cross_ref: DEP-005 — use patched OTel versions when implementing
backlog.fix: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node>=0.217.0. Create Source/Backend/src/tracing.ts. Inject trace/span IDs into logger. Propagate W3C traceparent.

backlog.title: dependencyCheckDuration histogram missing from metrics.ts (spec-drift: FR-dependency-metrics)
backlog.fix: Add dependency_check_duration_seconds Histogram to metrics.ts. Instrument isReady() and computeHasUnresolvedBlockers() in dependency.ts.

backlog.title: Traceability enforcer never checks Specifications/; non-deterministic plan selection
backlog.fix: Add explicit --plan flag. Add Specifications/ scanning with source-dir mapping. Fix FR ID regex to avoid body cross-references.

backlog.title: picomatch ReDoS — build-time/file-watch hang (GHSA-c2c7-rcm5-vvqj, CVSS 7.5)
backlog.fix: cd portal/Frontend && npm update picomatch

backlog.title: Duplicate test files — WorkItemDetailPage and WorkItemListPage
backlog.fix: Remove root-level duplicates. Keep tests/pages/ variants as canonical.

backlog.title: Logger always emits JSON — no dev pretty-print mode (spec-drift)
backlog.fix: Add NODE_ENV !== 'production' branch to logger emit function for human-readable output.

backlog.title: FR-dependency-seed unimplemented — no seed data at startup
backlog.fix: Create Source/Backend/src/store/seed.ts. Call at startup in app.ts when NODE_ENV=development.

backlog.title: Two logger abstractions coexist (shim + implementation — single-source-of-truth violation)
backlog.fix: Migrate all callers to single convention. Remove the shim. Consolidate into one logger file.

backlog.title: brace-expansion DoS (GHSA-f886-m6hf-6m8v, CVSS 6.5)
backlog.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm update brace-expansion

backlog.title: Vite path traversal in .map files (GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9) — dev only
backlog.fix: npm update vite (to 8.0.12+). Note: major version bump — also update vitest and related tooling.

backlog.title: esbuild CORS bypass (GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99) — dev only
backlog.fix: npm update esbuild (via vite upgrade)

backlog.title: PostCSS XSS via unescaped </style> (GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93, CVSS 6.1)
backlog.fix: npm update postcss in all affected workspaces

backlog.title: Vitest transitive vulnerabilities (via vite, vite-node)
backlog.fix: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vitest

backlog.title: express@4.x — 1 major version behind (5.2.1 available)
backlog.fix: Plan express 5.x migration with compatibility testing. Low urgency.

backlog.title: pino@8.x — 2 major versions behind (10.x available, improved structured logging)
backlog.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm update pino

backlog.title: Large transitive dependency tree in portal/Backend (577 total deps)
backlog.fix: Audit portal/Backend dep tree. Prune unused transitive deps. Enable npm audit in CI.

backlog.title: uuid@9.x — 5 major versions behind (v14 available, low risk)
backlog.fix: Update uuid when convenient.

backlog.title: No malicious post-install scripts detected (positive finding)
backlog.fix: No action required. Positive finding.

cross_references.title: OpenTelemetry Entirely Absent
cross_references.single_fix: Implement OTel in Source/Backend using @opentelemetry/sdk-node>=0.217.0. Resolves QO-004 and simultaneously patches DEP-005/006.

cross_references.title: ReDoS Vulnerability Cluster
cross_references.root_cause: Outdated regex-based routing/glob libraries with known ReDoS patterns
cross_references.single_fix: Batch npm update path-to-regexp picomatch across all affected workspaces in one PR.

passed_checks: No empty catch blocks (all log + rethrow or respond)
No test.skip or xit in test suites
